alt: Real ChatGPT /pomodoro execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /pomodoro Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive focused-study widget with three five-minute activities on training, inference and context. Include recall reveals and activity progress. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

observations: The generated timer controls change state, but a real-time countdown was not observed. The +1 min control displayed 04:00 after the initial 05:00. The activity answers, reveals and completion controls were exercised.

actions.label: Activate the study session with Start.
Pause the session and inspect the displayed time.
Use the +1 min control and inspect the displayed time.
Write a training explanation at normal speed.
Mark the training recall as completed.
Explain why prompt context does not prove changed weights.
Compare the answer with the expected explanation.
Open the context and retrieval activity.
Write a retrieval explanation at normal speed.
Revisit Training with the saved written response.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
